note: Independent rejudgment 2026-11-15. Following a Cache Reset, RFC 6810 Section 6.3 says: 'If there are no more preferred caches, it MUST issue a Reset Query and get an entire new load from the cache.' The diagrams and Section 5 define these as version-0 PDUs. Current handlePDU refuses a version-0 Cache Reset rather than entering its Cache Reset recovery branch; its version-negotiation branch rejects version 0, and syncOnce never retries below rtrVersionMin=1. An initial unsupported version and a version change within an established response now have distinct errors, but neither reaches version-0 recovery. The version-1/2 whole-set replacement path does not meet the version-0 exchange. No test carries this id; its declared version-0 gap remains unimplemented.
